# Abenaki Ski Team

> > Youth ski racing and instruction nonprofit serving Wolfeboro, NH with Alpine, Freestyle, Nordic, and Learn to Ski programs for ages 4-18

Abenaki Ski Team operates as part of the Abenaki Outing Club, a 501(c)(3) organization offering USSA-sanctioned racing programs and beginner ski lessons at Abenaki Ski Area and partner mountains including Gunstock, Pats Peak, and McIntyre. The team is led by coaching staff including Scott Martineau, Gordon Ling, and Vanessa Peterson.

## Key Topics

- Alpine skiing programs (U8-U16 USSA racing)
- Learn to Ski lessons (ages 4-7)
- Freestyle skiing and snowboarding
- Nordic skiing programs
- USSA membership and racing
- Small Mountain Series
- Abenaki Ski Area (home mountain)
- Tuition rates and scholarships
- Volunteer work credit program
- Home race events (Boxer Short Race, Chewy Slalom)
- Equipment rentals and season passes
- Youth development (ages 4-18)
- Wolfeboro Parks & Recreation partnership
- NHARA (New Hampshire Alpine Racing Association)
- 501(c)(3) nonprofit ski team

## Registration & Programs

- [Learn to Ski | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/learn-to-ski-registration): Learn to Ski registration for ages 4-7 with tuition rates & scholarships
- [Alpine Race Registration | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/alpine-race-registration): Alpine race registration U8-U16 with tuition, USSA & NHARA membership info
- [Freestyle Registration | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/freestyle-registration): Freestyle ski & snowboard registration ages 7-14 with Small Mountain Series
- [Our Program | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/about-learn-to-ski): Learn to Ski program details: 5 lessons for ages 4-7 beginners

## Races & Events

- [Home Events | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/races-events): Home race schedule: Ski Sale, Boxer Short Race, USSA Dual SL, Chewy Slalom
- [U10 Alpine Race | Abenaki Ski Team](https://abenakiskiteam.org/about-u10-race): U10 Alpine program philosophy: agility, balance & coordination development
